commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' The corner from Brian Rodriguez (Uruguay) is cleared away by the defence.
90+8' Brian Rodriguez (Uruguay) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Uruguay can continue in their attacking effort.
90+7' Uruguay take a short corner kick.
90+7' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) is cleared to safety by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Uruguay are awarded a corner kick.
90+7' The attendance for today's match is 62764.

90+6' Brian Rodriguez (Uruguay) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mohammed Al Owais. Uruguay force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+6' Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

90+5' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Uruguay will have a corner.
90+3' Today's match ends for Firas Al Buraikan who will be replaced by Alaa Hejji (Saudi Arabia).
90+3' Uruguay earn a corner.

90+3' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Uruguay earn a corner.
90+3' Georgios Donis has decided to make a change. Abdullah Al Hamdan (Saudi Arabia) replaces Moteb Al Harbi.
90+3' Substitution. Saud Abdulhamid walks off the pitch and Ali Lajami (Saudi Arabia) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' Corner kick. Uruguay will have an opportunity.
90+2' Guillermo Varela (Uruguay) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Corner kick. Uruguay will have an opportunity.
90+1' Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Mohammed Al Owais pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A substitution has been made. Federico Vinas is replaced by Rodrigo Aguirre (Uruguay).
90' Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

89' Brian Rodriguez (Uruguay) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Uruguay have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' The linesman signals that Juan Sanabria (Uruguay) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

87' Close! Saud Abdulhamid (Saudi Arabia) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Uruguay will have a goal kick.
86' Juan Sanabria (Uruguay) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
84' Brian Rodriguez (Uruguay) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.

83' Sebastian Caceres (Uruguay) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
83' Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) prepares to take a corner kick.
81' Here is a change. Mohammed Abu Al Shamat is going off and Georgios Donis gives the last tactical orders to Nawaf Mashari Abdulrahman Boushal (Saudi Arabia).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximiliano Araujo departs the field of play to be replaced by Brian Rodriguez (Uruguay).
80' 1 - 1 Goal! Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
80' Mohammed Al Owais makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Federico Vinas (Uruguay) after a cross from the side.
80' Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
78' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
76' Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
75' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia).
74' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) takes the corner which is cleared.
73' The corner from Federico Valverde (Uruguay) is hurriedly cleared.
73' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Uruguay.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Ugarte trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay).
69' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

68' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
67' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) releases a promising shot from the set piece towards the middle of the target, but Mohammed Al Owais makes a save to deny him.
66' Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Uruguay in a dangerous position.
65' Rodrigo Bentancur (Uruguay) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
63' That's the end of the game for Musab Al Juwayr, who is replaced by Nasser Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia).
63' Mohammed Al Owais (Saudi Arabia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
61' Mohammed Al Owais (Saudi Arabia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Manuel Ugarte (Uruguay) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!

58' What a chance that is! Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
54' Mathias Olivera (Uruguay) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
53' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

53' Guillermo Varela (Uruguay) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Uruguay.
52' The game is interrupted as Federico Vinas (Uruguay) is flagged offside.
51' Federico Vinas (Uruguay) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
50' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) will take a corner kick.
50' Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Uruguay force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
48' Federico Vinas (Uruguay) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
47' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Federico Vinas (Uruguay) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
46' Half-time substitution. Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) is replaced by Agustin Canobbio.
46' Marcelo Bielsa has made a change at the break. Juan Sanabria (Uruguay) has come on in place of Matias Vina.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Matias Vina (Uruguay) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) heads on.
45+1' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Uruguay.
45' Federico Vinas (Uruguay) connects with the resultant free kick but produces a header straight at Mohammed Al Owais.
44' Today's referee Maurizio Mariani rightly decides to book Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) for his harsh tackle.
41' 1 - 0 Goal! Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

41' Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than low towards the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
40' The ball goes behind for a corner. Saudi Arabia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

40' Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Saudi Arabia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

39' The ball rebounds to Abdullah Al Khaibari (Saudi Arabia) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Uruguay will have a goal kick.
38' The linesman points to the corner flag, Saudi Arabia are going to take it.

38' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) inside the box and he manages to steer it under the bar. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Fernando Muslera makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
38' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Saudi Arabia.
37' The resulting free kick from Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia) ends up in the gloves of the keeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Saudi Arabia.
36' Rodrigo Bentancur (Uruguay) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Saudi Arabia.
34' Matias Vina (Uruguay) serves up a nice cross, but Mohammed Al Owais punches the ball away. The foul by Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) was seen by Maurizio Mariani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
33' Manuel Ugarte (Uruguay) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' A header by Federico Vinas (Uruguay) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Mohammed Al Owais, who makes a nice save.
28' Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia) commits a foul and Maurizio Mariani immediately signals a free kick.
24' A cooling break is underway.
23' Federico Vinas (Uruguay) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
22' The resulting corner from Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia) comes to nothing.
21' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
20' Saud Abdulhamid (Saudi Arabia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Uruguay have a free kick.
19' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) is penalised for a foul. Maurizio Mariani had a clear view and blows his whistle.

18' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Uruguay will have a goal kick.
16' Federico Vinas (Uruguay) tries to find Matias Vina, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
11' Abdullah Al Khaibari (Saudi Arabia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
8' A cross from Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
7' Guillermo Varela (Uruguay) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Maurizio Mariani saw the whole situation.
6' Federico Vinas (Uruguay) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
5' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
5' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Mohammed Al Owais. Uruguay will take a corner kick.
3' Abdullah Al Khaibari (Saudi Arabia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

Saudi Arabia will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will supervise the game today.
